words.example: The pain in his back got worse after the long walk.
words.example_cn: 走了很远的路后他的背更疼了。

words.example: Physical exercises build up the muscles of the body.
words.example_cn: 体育锻炼能增强身体肌肉。

words.example: Vaccines help doctors prevent many serious infectious diseases.
words.example_cn: 疫苗帮助医生预防许多严重的传染病。

words.example: She broke the world record in the hundred-metre race.
words.example_cn: 她在百米赛跑中打破了世界纪录。

words.example: After the long walk we had a good rest.
words.example_cn: 走了很长的路后我们好好休息了一下。

words.example: Getting up early is part of his morning routine.
words.example_cn: 早起是他每天早晨的惯例。

words.example: Teenagers need eight to nine hours of sleep nightly.
words.example_cn: 青少年每晚需要八到九个小时的睡眠。

words.example: Team sports teach children how to work with others.
words.example_cn: 团队运动教会孩子如何与他人合作。

words.example: Regular exercise will increase your muscle strength slowly.
words.example_cn: 经常锻炼会逐渐增强你的肌肉力量。

words.example: Our class basketball team practises after school daily.
words.example_cn: 我们班篮球队每天放学后训练。

words.example: The doctors treated his injury quickly and very carefully.
words.example_cn: 医生们迅速而非常仔细地治疗了他的伤。

words.example: The whole city celebrated the team's great victory.
words.example_cn: 整座城市都在庆祝球队的伟大胜利。

words.example: Running every morning helped him lose some weight slowly.
words.example_cn: 每天早上跑步帮助他慢慢减轻了一些体重。

words.example: The company advertised its new product on television.
words.example_cn: 这家公司在电视上为其新产品做广告。

words.example: We cannot afford another week of holiday this year.
words.example_cn: 今年我们再也抽不出一个星期的假期了。

words.example: May I borrow your umbrella for the walk home?
words.example_cn: 我可以借你的伞走回家吗？

words.example: He started a small business selling handmade bags.
words.example_cn: 他做起了卖手工包的小生意。

words.example: She chose teaching as her career for the whole life.
words.example_cn: 她选择教书作为自己毕生的职业。

words.example: He discussed the project with his colleagues after lunch.
words.example_cn: 午饭后他和同事讨论了这个项目。

words.example: Her father works for a foreign company downtown.
words.example_cn: 她爸爸在市中心一家外国公司工作。

words.example: Prices are rising and consumers are worried about money.
words.example_cn: 物价上涨，消费者为钱发愁。

words.example: The new phone cost him two months' salary.
words.example_cn: 这部新手机花了他两个月的工资。

words.example: The shop treats every customer with patience and smiles.
words.example_cn: 这家店耐心微笑地对待每位顾客。

words.example: The demand for electric cars grows every year.
words.example_cn: 对电动汽车的需求每年都在增长。

words.example: Students can get a ten percent discount on tickets.
words.example_cn: 学生买票可以享受九折优惠。

words.example: He earns money by delivering newspapers at weekends.
words.example_cn: 他靠周末送报纸挣钱。

words.example: The country's economy grew quickly over the past ten years.
words.example_cn: 这个国家的经济在过去十年增长迅速。

words.example: The factory employs more than five hundred workers.
words.example_cn: 这家工厂雇用了五百多名工人。

words.example: The old factory was turned into an art centre.
words.example_cn: 这座老工厂被改造成了一个艺术中心。

words.example: The tourist industry brings hope to the small town.
words.example_cn: 旅游业给这座小镇带来了希望。

words.example: He prepared carefully for tomorrow's important job interview.
words.example_cn: 他认真准备了明天重要的求职面试。

words.example: She found a part-time job in a bookshop.
words.example_cn: 她在一家书店找到一份兼职工作。

words.example: The manager met with visitors from another city.
words.example_cn: 经理会见了来自另一个城市的客人。

words.example: We bought fresh vegetables at the morning market.
words.example_cn: 我们在早市买了新鲜蔬菜。

words.example: The head teacher's office is on the second floor.
words.example_cn: 班主任的办公室在二楼。

words.example: They own a small coffee shop near the school.
words.example_cn: 他们在学校附近拥有一家小咖啡馆。

words.example: Customers can pay by card or with their phones.
words.example_cn: 顾客可以用卡或手机付款。

words.example: The price of the ticket includes the museum visit.
words.example_cn: 票的价格包括参观博物馆。

words.example: This new product is popular with young people.
words.example_cn: 这款新产品很受年轻人欢迎。

words.example: Nursing is a hard but very respected profession today.
words.example_cn: 护理如今是一份辛苦但很受尊敬的职业。

words.example: My uncle will retire from teaching after this year.
words.example_cn: 我叔叔今年之后将从教学岗位上退休。

words.example: She receives a good salary for her hard work.
words.example_cn: 她的努力工作换来了不错的薪水。

words.example: The hotel is famous for its excellent service.
words.example_cn: 这家酒店以优质的服务闻名。

words.example: The dam supplies electricity to the whole region.
words.example_cn: 这座大坝为整个地区供电。

words.example: Small companies pay a lower tax every year.
words.example_cn: 小企业每年缴纳的税较少。

words.example: Trade between the two countries has grown quickly.
words.example_cn: 两国之间的贸易增长迅速。

words.example: Good health matters far more than great wealth.
words.example_cn: 健康远比巨大的财富重要。

words.example: He finished all his work before the meeting began.
words.example_cn: 他在会议开始前完成了所有工作。

words.example: You can achieve your goal with daily effort.
words.example_cn: 通过每天的努力你能实现自己的目标。

words.example: Speaking two languages is a great advantage today.
words.example_cn: 如今会说两种语言是一个很大的优势。

words.example: We all agreed to meet at the school gate.
words.example_cn: 我们一致同意在校门口见面。

words.example: The rules do not allow phones during class.
words.example_cn: 规定不允许上课时使用手机。

words.example: They often argue about environmental problems at lunchtime.
words.example_cn: 午饭时他们常常争论环境问题。

words.example: Volunteering brings benefits to both others and yourself.
words.example_cn: 做志愿者对他人和自己都有好处。

words.example: Careless driving often causes many serious road accidents.
words.example_cn: 粗心驾驶常常造成许多严重的交通事故。

words.example: Learning a new language is a real challenge.
words.example_cn: 学习一门新语言是真正的挑战。

words.example: The study reached an important conclusion last month.
words.example_cn: 这项研究上个月得出了一个重要结论。

words.example: We are carefully considering travelling abroad this summer holiday.
words.example_cn: 我们正在认真考虑今年暑假出国旅行。

words.example: She decided to study harder for the next exam.
words.example_cn: 她决定为下次考试更努力学习。

words.example: The number of car accidents decreased last year.
words.example_cn: 去年交通事故的数量减少了。

words.example: The city developed quickly over the past ten years.
words.example_cn: 这座城市在过去十年发展迅速。

words.example: Let's spend some time discussing the new plan today.
words.example_cn: 我们今天花点时间讨论一下新计划吧。

words.example: I have no doubt that she will succeed.
words.example_cn: 我毫不怀疑她会成功。

words.example: Water is essential for all living things on earth.
words.example_cn: 水对地球上所有生物都是必需的。

words.example: There is strong evidence that the climate is changing.
words.example_cn: 有有力的证据表明气候正在变化。

words.example: The students exchanged ideas about their future jobs happily.
words.example_cn: 学生们愉快地交流了对未来工作的想法。

words.example: We expect the results to come next Monday.
words.example_cn: 我们预计结果下周一公布。

words.example: The number of readers has increased greatly this year.
words.example_cn: 今年读者的数量大大增加。

words.example: Good teachers have a lifelong influence on students.
words.example_cn: 好老师对学生有一生的影响。

words.example: It is obvious that he has prepared carefully.
words.example_cn: 很明显他做了精心的准备。

words.example: In my opinion, reading is better than watching TV.
words.example_cn: 在我看来，阅读比看电视好。

words.example: She finally found a permanent job after graduation.
words.example_cn: 毕业后她终于找到了一份固定工作。

words.example: There is still a possibility of catching the early train.
words.example_cn: 仍有赶上早班火车的可能性。

words.example: The purpose of the trip is to learn local history.
words.example_cn: 这次旅行的目的是学习当地历史。

words.example: Hard work is the main reason for his success.
words.example_cn: 努力工作是他人成功的主要原因。

words.example: He politely refused the offer of a ride.
words.example_cn: 他礼貌地拒绝了搭载的好意。

words.example: Her business has been successful for many years.
words.example_cn: 她的生意多年来一直很成功。

words.example: I suppose the meeting will start a little later.
words.example_cn: 我想会议会稍微晚点开始。

words.example: They found a temporary flat near the school.
words.example_cn: 他们在学校附近找了个临时住所。

words.example: He was ill; therefore, he missed the important meeting.
words.example_cn: 他病了，因此错过了重要的会议。

words.example: The club offers various activities for its members.
words.example_cn: 俱乐部为会员提供各种各样的活动。

words.example: From the hill we had a wonderful view of the lake.
words.example_cn: 从山上我们能欣赏到美丽的湖景。
